S46.01.needs: a paid account (Create video is offered only to an entitled tier)
S46.01.note: The + button's exact visible label was not confirmed in the code.
steps: Sign in and open a new chat.
Click the + button in the composer and click Create video.
Type a text prompt in the composer and press send.
Look for a video placeholder in the chat that becomes a playable clip, and compare with Expected.
S46.01.where: Composer > + menu > Create video, then type a prompt and send

steps: Turn on video mode with Composer > + menu > Create video.
Click the model button in the composer that shows a model name (aria-label Select video model).
Look at the list of video models that opens and pick one.
Check that the button now shows the chosen model name.
S46.05.where: Composer (video mode on) > Select video model button

S46.06.note: The length pill is inside the video-mode controls; the options depend on the chosen model and quality.
steps: Turn on video mode with Composer > + menu > Create video.
Click the pill button that shows a length such as 5s (aria-label Select video length).
Look at the menu of options, each shown as N seconds, and pick one.
Check that the pill now shows the chosen length before sending.
S46.06.where: Composer (video mode on) > Select video length button

steps: Turn on video mode with Composer > + menu > Create video.
Click the pill that shows a ratio such as 16:9 (aria-label Select video aspect ratio).
Pick another ratio from the menu labelled Video aspect ratio.
Check that the pill shows the new ratio and the menu closes.
S46.07.where: Composer (video mode on) > Select video aspect ratio button

S46.08.needs: a paid account, a finished clip to check the resolution
S46.08.note: The UI offers quality labels, not raw pixel sizes; checking the output resolution needs a file tool outside the app.
steps: Turn on video mode with Composer > + menu > Create video.
Click the pill that shows a quality label (aria-label Select video quality).
Pick another quality from the menu labelled Video quality.
Send a prompt and compare the clip's resolution with the chosen quality.
S46.08.where: Composer (video mode on) > Select video quality button

S46.26.needs: a paid account, a video generation in progress
steps: Send a video prompt in video mode.
Look at the placeholder that appears in the reply, with a progress bar named Video progress and a percentage.
Watch the percentage and the elapsed time change while the clip is generated.
Compare with Expected: the user sees progress until the clip is ready.
S46.26.where: Chat, after sending a video prompt > progress placeholder in the reply

S46.27.note: The estimate text is built as a template in the code; whether it is shown as visible text or only as a tooltip was not fully confirmed.
steps: Turn on video mode with Composer > + menu > Create video and pick a video model.
Choose a length, ratio and quality.
Look for the note that starts with This video is estimated at near the video pills; hover it to see the full text in the tooltip.
Compare the amount with your available credits, and after sending check the cost once the clip is done.
S46.27.where: Composer (video mode on, a video model selected) > estimate note near the video pills

S46.28.needs: a paid account, a video generation still in progress
S46.28.note: Server-side cancellation has special cases for providers; whether the job ends for every provider was not checked.
steps: Start a video generation in video mode.
While the progress placeholder is shown, click Stop generating at its top-right.
Look for the button to change to Stopping… and then for the note Cancellation requested.
Check that the placeholder stops progressing and the job ends, and compare with Expected.
S46.28.where: Chat, during a video generation > Stop generating button on the progress placeholder

S46.29.needs: a failed video job marked retryable (hard to produce on demand)
S46.29.note: A second Retry button also appears on a video player that fails to load; it is not the failed-job retry.
steps: Find a failed video reply titled Video generation ended.
Read the text under it; the button shows only when the job is marked as retryable.
Click Try video again.
Check that a new video starts with the same model, ratio, quality and length as before.
S46.29.where: Chat, a failed video reply > Try video again button

S46.30.needs: a Free or paid account with at least one finished clip
S46.30.note: The Library entry in the sidebar can be hidden by a setting; the tab labels are All, Images, Videos, Documents, Artifacts, Uploads and Generated files.
steps: Click Library in the sidebar.
Click the Videos tab.
Look for all finished clips listed together in the gallery.

S46.31.needs: a finished clip in the account
S46.31.note: The chat clip has native controls labelled Generated video; the opening step in the Library viewer was not traced in detail.
steps: Open Library > Videos.
Click a clip to open it in the viewer.
Use the player controls to play, pause and drag the timeline.
Compare with Expected: the clip plays, pauses and scrubs.
S46.31.where: Library > Videos tab > click a clip; or the clip in the chat reply

S46.32.needs: a finished clip in a chat
S46.32.note: The Library viewer also has a Download button named Download plus the file name.
steps: Open a finished clip in a chat reply.
Hover over the clip, or Tab to it, so the round Download video button shows at its top-right.
Click Download video.
Check that the file saves to the Downloads folder as a playable video.
S46.32.where: Chat, finished video reply > Download video button (top-right of the clip)
